name: Outlook Mail
summary: Search and read messages from Outlook inboxes

tools.name: outlook_inbox
tools.description: List recent messages from the Outlook inbox, or any other mail folder.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 10).

folder.description: Mail folder to read (default: inbox). Well-known folder names: inbox, junkemail, deleteditems, sentitems, drafts, outbox, archive, clutter, conflicts, conversationhistory, localfailures, recoverableitemsdeletions, scheduled, searchfolders, serverfailures, syncissues.

tools.name: outlook_search
tools.description: Search Outlook messages by query text, sender, subject, or date range.

query.description: Full-text search across subject and body.

since.description: Only messages received on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

before.description: Only messages received on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: outlook_read
tools.description: Read a specific Outlook message by its ID, including full body content.

message_id.description: The Microsoft Graph message ID to retrieve.

tools.name: outlook_save_attachments
tools.description: Download attachments from an Outlook message to a local directory. Also saves the message body as body.html. Useful for processing emails that contain inline images (e.g., USPS Informed Delivery).

output_dir.description: Local directory path to save attachments to (created if needed).
